stem: A deal on Earbuds Pro X shows a large promo uplift. Earbuds Lite, which customers often buy instead, lost sales in the same weeks. What does judging the deal on the uplift of Pro X alone miss?

options.text: Nothing: Lite is a different product, so its sales do not count
The cannibalised Lite sales, which should be netted off the gain
A halo on Lite, which should be added to the uplift of Pro X
The own-price elasticity of Pro X, which cancels out the uplift
